text:
Maya (Finance): Quick update: temporary vendor payment/process tweak for next 3 weeks to smooth month-end AP. Effective Tue May 28. See summary: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Short+AP+Process+Update :calendar:

Tom K: What's changing exactly?

Maya (Finance): Two main items: 1) PCard single-transaction cap lowered to $2k (temporary) for non-critical purchases. 2) For vendor invoices >$7k, we require PO + vendor banking details earlier in the intake. This avoids ACH delays.

Nina (Sales Ops): We have a partner onboarding with a $6.5k invoice due next week. That falls under what path?

Maya (Finance): < $7k: standard AP. If you want guaranteed same-week payment, create a PO and tag the ticket "fast-pay". We'll prioritize.

Sasha (Accounting): Note on receipts: for any PCard transaction, attach the vendor invoice + receipt in the card reconciliation ticket. Missing invoice = payment hold. Also if PCard used for SaaS subscriptions, include subscription URL and account owner.

procure-bot: procurement ticket created: FIN-2026-3344 by Nina (Sales Ops) — status: awaiting finance intake.

Tom K: For vendor onboarding >$7k, is SOC2 still required? The vendor is small and only deals with anonymized metrics.

Maya (Finance): For >$7k we require a risk self-attestation at minimum. If the vendor processes customer data or has access to infra, we escalate to full vendor risk review (SOC2). Use the checklist link on the page.

Nina (Sales Ops): Will the temporary PCard cap affect recurring subscriptions billed monthly?

Sasha (Accounting): Recurring SaaS under $1k/month unaffected. Anything billed annually >$2k needs a PO/finance ticket.

Tom K: If we need to exceed the temporary cap for a launch, what's the process?

Maya (Finance): Add "launch-exception" tag to the procurement ticket, include PM + Eng manager sign-off. Finance will review within 24 hours. Legal may add time if contract changes are requested.

Nina (Sales Ops): Thanks — I'll create the PO and attach vendor banking info.

Maya (Finance): We'll monitor the advisory window and publish a short digest every Friday listing pending fast-pay requests. Expect this to be in place for three weeks only. Full write-up + form: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Short+AP+Process+Update :spiral_note_pad:

Sasha (Accounting): I'll update the PO template to include the banking fields and invoice upload step.

Tom K: :thumbsup: saved the link.

Maya (Finance): Thanks all — ping finance if anything blocks your launch.
